query:
WITH enrolled_ids AS (
    SELECT unnest($1::uuid[]) AS researched_account_id
)
SELECT
    enrolled_ids.researched_account_id AS "researched_account_id!",
    latest_run.latest_research_at AS "latest_research_at?",
    active_run.id AS "active_pipeline_run_id?",
    COALESCE(active_run.signal_backfill_succeeded, FALSE) AS "active_run_signal_backfill_succeeded!",
    COALESCE(active_run.signal_classification_succeeded, FALSE) AS "active_run_signal_classification_succeeded!"
FROM enrolled_ids
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(run.started_at, run.created_at) AS latest_research_at
    FROM account_research_pipeline_runs run
    WHERE run.researched_account_id = enrolled_ids.researched_account_id
    ORDER BY run.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
) latest_run ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        run.id,
        EXISTS(
            SELECT 1
            FROM account_research_pipeline_stages stage
            WHERE stage.run_id = run.id
              AND stage.stage = 'SIGNAL_BACKFILL'::account_research_pipeline_stage
              AND stage.status = 'SUCCEEDED'::account_research_pipeline_stage_status
        ) AS signal_backfill_succeeded,
        EXISTS(
            SELECT 1
            FROM account_research_pipeline_stages stage
            WHERE stage.run_id = run.id
              AND stage.stage = 'SIGNAL_CLASSIFICATION'::account_research_pipeline_stage
              AND stage.status = 'SUCCEEDED'::account_research_pipeline_stage_status
        ) AS signal_classification_succeeded
    FROM account_research_pipeline_runs run
    WHERE run.researched_account_id = enrolled_ids.researched_account_id
      AND run.status IN (
          'PENDING'::account_research_pipeline_run_status,
          'RUNNING'::account_research_pipeline_run_status,
          'WAITING_FOR_USER'::account_research_pipeline_run_status,
          'BLOCKED'::account_research_pipeline_run_status
      )
    ORDER BY run.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
) active_run ON TRUE
